purpose: Machine-readable record of experiments already performed, their results, and the questions they answer. Prevents repeated tests and preserves negative evidence. Consult before proposing any new simulation.
scope_note: Inventory of the current traffic_shepherd (CIRCLES-era) program and all archived pre-CIRCLES research families. Sealed raw acceptance outcomes were never read; sealed blocks are recorded by permitted metadata only, with outcomes marked uninspected. Evidence-organization task: zero new simulations.

sign_conventions.improvements_convention: Fields named 'improvements' in run analyses are damping-minus-treatment (or control-minus-treatment): positive = treatment improved on that cost. Cited explicitly where used.
sign_conventions.cost_delta_convention: Where reports display 'treatment cost - damping cost', positive = treatment worse. Several historical prose tables mix these conventions; per-entry 'corrections' fields flag known instances.
sign_conventions.delay: Positive delay delta = extra travel time (a cost). Sustained-wall program reports median incremental delay in s/vehicle and totals in seconds.
sign_conventions.simulated_seconds: Budgets are charged simulated seconds (SUMO episode seconds), not wall-clock.

entries.name: Stage 1c: release arms R1/R2 vs reference holds (120 seeds x 5 arms)

R1 PROVABLY INERT: digest bit-identical to W_HOLD on 120/120 (its speed gate includes the walled band; arrival <= 0.9 x discharge never occurs on plateau demand). R2 fires on 33%/43%/23%/47% of seeds (2200->2700).
entries.results: Median delta incremental delay vs D (total s; loss fraction; Wilcoxon p): 2200 W_ORACLE +2752 (100% loss, p<1e-4); 2400 +1972 (p=0.058, hinge); 2600 -3081 (p=0.006); 2700 -4921 (p=8e-4). R2: +2014/+908/-4582/-7053. DELAY SIGN FLIPS WITH DEMAND (+2.0-2.8k s at 2200-2400; -3.1 to -7.1k s at 2600-2700). Mechanism: D onsets <= 250 s on 5/26, 20/30, 27/30, 29/30 of D-collapsed seeds by cell - the wall cannot prevent a collapse that starts before it engages. Recovery (no sustained collapse among D-collapsed): 2200 46% (oracle/R1), 2400 7%, 2600/2700 0%. W_ORACLE over-hold loses completions at 2600/2700 (-14.5, -13.5, p<1e-3). Hard-brake median excess +98 to +300 vehicle-steps vs D exceeding the max(2,10%) budget on >= 97% of seeds in every cell/arm (dose-linked comfort cost). R2 vs W_HOLD on by-rule seeds: better 6/10, 8/13, 2/7, 6/14 - 'works and is safe but weak', near coin-flip.
entries.criteria_verdict: No gate attached (per reset policy); reading: regime-dependent with clean mechanism; R1 must be redesigned or dropped; no regime where holding past t=901 is the better reference; the decision variable is onset-time-relative-to-t_d.

WON vs best fixed: ties at 2400 (+67 [-947,+1117]) and 2600 (+149 [-2123,+2357]); significantly WORSE at 2700 (+3829 [+1454,+6130]). R1b never fires: 0/90 (outcome-identical to W_ORACLE to the cent). Part C: L0' fair baseline (upstream_inflow_30s > 21 or near_merge_count > 44-45) OOF value 1.471 (lambda=0, engagement 0.53); L1' refit OOF R2 0.168/Spearman 0.414/AUC 0.757/Brier 0.214 - indistinguishable from L1 on defective vectors (repaired features do not move delay prediction); policy values lambda=0: L0' 1.471, L1' 1.631; HEADLINE: L1' does NOT beat L0' at lambda=0 (+0.160 [-0.014,+0.328]). C3 onset prediction: label 'D onset within next 100 s' (base rate 0.124): univariate merge_edge_mean_speed AUC 0.832; multivariate grouped-CV L2 logistic OOF AUC 0.944 (vs W-arm delay delta R2 0.168/AUC 0.760). entries.results: VERDICT: existing evidence is INSUFFICIENT to decide whether pre-decision CAV reports can identify when a feasible wall beats damping. (1) Entry-frame inventory: 12 executed wall-vs-damping entry comparisons across 6 seeds; 7 complete maneuvers = 1 beneficial (4117 fixed wall: service -5.216, braking -0.065, effort -4.713, ttc -0.056, wait -0.052 per request, 0 collisions - improves all five continuous metrics), 5 harmful, 1 nonbeneficial; plus 5 no-delivery cells, PPO multi-component arms, refusals, mechanics-only fixtures and the missing 4118 rule cell kept separate. (2) Plumbing is NOT the blocker: causal pre-decision report histories (decision snapshots + full receipt streams) exist for every cell; the provenance-bound dataset (CELL_REGISTRY.json, PREDECISION_OBSERVATIONS.json) aligns observations, executed actions and registered outcomes. (3) Fitting is inadmissible: one positive label cannot support a scenario-grouped fit/evaluate split; no model was fitted. (4) t=600 binding audit: cohort identity was frozen from the damping reference's t=600 snapshot; BOTH executed PPO dev activations (560/565 s) and 19/24 training activations preceded it, so their observations/actions embed future-selected membership - the PPO 4115 'beneficial' is NOT deployable-causal evidence; the clean positive is only 4117-fixed. (5) Metastability diagnostics: 4107-m2700-t600 and 4115 have near-identical observable profiles (approach mean 8.7 vs 9.3 m/s, near-merge 6 vs 6, all-mean 19.0 vs 17.5) with OPPOSITE service signs (-8.4 vs +2.7) - unobserved realization differences demonstrably matter at this contract (possibility C is live); 4115 vs 4117 differ observably (approach 9.3 vs 14.6, near-merge 6 vs 1) with opposite outcomes (A/B not excluded); 4108-t600 resembles 4117's regime yet was worst (+16.7) so no monotone single-observable rule separates the classes. Effect MAGNITUDE class is observable-supported (all m2000 cells ~0-effect at all-mean ~28 m/s vs large effects at m2700). Within-realization action sensitivity is real (28.03 s/req H5-vs-H20; PPO-vs-fixed flips) but cross-realization predictability is undemonstrated. (6) Smallest missing evidence (PROPOSAL OE-01-P, not executed, needs its own registration + authorization): staged replication of the 4117 configuration (lifecycle_v2 fixed wall t600/H20/mean-2-capped-24) on exposed-partition remainder seeds 4119-4132 (EXPOSURE CAVEAT: 4121-4132 carry archived IDM-era assignments, DEC-02 - audit before any use), stage A 2 seeds x 2 arms = 9600 s (stop if both nonbeneficial/harmful), stage B on >=1 beneficial replication 4 more seeds x 2 arms = 19200 s, hard ceiling 28800 s, t600-only decisions bound from the arm's own current reports (leak eliminated by construction), per-seed matched references with report-prefix identity asserted, full outcome vector + OE-01 observation capture; no threshold search or perturbations.
entries.criteria_verdict: Not applicable to a new action: no new simulation. Against the question asked: observations cannot currently be tested for benefit selection because the walls tested produced exactly one qualifying outcome (unreplicated); 'always damping' remains the only policy consistent with all 12 measured entry labels.

entries.name: entry_observability_v3: literature-grounded observation investigation - 4 primary sources synthesized (none predicts intervention benefit; no feature ablations to import), existing feature audit ([I] regional_reports + proposal_features cover hypotheses B/C/D), compact 3-group contract extracted and tested on 14 causal cells, LOSO comparison NEGATIVE (no addition beats the demand-class constant; G-MERGE coverage-limited at p20) - zero simulation
entries.question: Is there a small, defensible observation specification for predicting the incremental physical effects of a specific feasible wall versus damping - what does the literature support, what is acquirable in our system, what is implemented/tested, and does anything improve wall decisions?
entries.controller: n/a (zero simulation; extraction over saved causal decision snapshots and telemetry streams).
entries.baseline_cf: n/a. Exploratory benchmark: demand-class constant (class read from observable all_mean_speed >= 25 m/s).
entries.scenario: The 14 causally valid fixed-wall cells (CUR-09 8, PP-06 dev fixed-wall 4, OE-02 2) at their decision times; PPO pre-t600 cells remain excluded (contaminated).
entries.seeds_splits: 8 independent seed groups (4107, 4108, 4115-4120); leave-one-seed-group-out evaluation.
entries.observation_contract: Predeclared 3-group compact contract (FEATURE_AUDIT.md section 3): G-SPATIAL (downstream-approach differential, bottleneck slow fraction, 30 s downstream trend), G-MERGE (ramp reporter mean speed, mainline-ramp differential), G-BURDEN (required slowdown, predicted assembly via registered admission, min member runway) - all on acquired-and-received<=decision reports only, explicit missingness, executed-cohort proposal identity. No window/threshold search.

entries.comparators: Current observation set (approach/all mean speed) vs the 3 proposed groups, univariate OLS LOSO, complete-case per feature; demand-class constant benchmark on each feature subset.
entries.matching_reuse: Reused OE-01 registry/observation functions, OE-03 DATASET_V2 cells, saved snapshots/telemetry, registered admission primitives (make_proposal/remaining_plan) for the assembly estimate.
entries.requested_vs_delivered: n/a (zero simulation).
entries.results: (1) LITERATURE: CIRCLES observes a singleton [ego speed, leader speed, bumper gap] (local frozen implementation; abstract-level paper) - our reports are already information-richer than the baseline controller; coordinated VSL (2435643, abstract level, full text 403) targets merge speed differentials and critical density via section detectors we do not have; shockwave reconstruction (2402.00063, abstract level) makes wave-front state a derived estimator, not an observed fact (not implemented); merging prediction (2304.00397, full text) uses the interacting pair's positions/speeds/prior actions with an ideal-coordinator assumption and performs NO feature ablation - nothing imports on authority. (2) AUDIT: hypotheses B/C/D are substantially implemented (regional_reports regions incl. ramp; proposal_features burden packet; selector admission) and were aggregated into decision-time features for the first time; A's core features already exist (no duplicates added); wave-front left as optional unimplemented estimator. (3) COVERAGE REALITY: only 3/14 decision snapshots contain a ramp reporter (p20 ramp-CAV sparsity); 3 snapshots lack bottleneck reporters - explicit missingness, G-MERGE tested on n=3. (4) EXPLORATORY COMPARISON NEGATIVE: LOSO MAE model vs demand-class constant - approach 5.707/5.643, all-speed 5.613/5.643, downstream-approach 6.543/6.043, bottleneck-slow 6.244/5.561 (n=10), downstream trend 6.132/5.643, ramp 6.612/6.602 (n=3), required slowdown 7.555/5.643, runway 6.794/5.643, predicted assembly 6.251/5.643 - NO addition beats the demand-class constant; with 8 groups the test has little power, and on the power it has the additions do not improve wall decisions. (5) OE-03 study refined: violation-conditional q90 replaced by violation counts + realized worst case (sparse samples); observation freeze list specified; strict episode labels preserved. NOT authorized, NOT launched.
entries.criteria_verdict: Unchanged criteria; no production threshold or controller selection proposed.
entries.limitations: 8 independent groups give little power (MAE differences of ~0.5 are noise); planning variance from the same cells; retrieval levels mixed (2 abstract-level sources); ramp coverage at p20 limits G-MERGE structurally; wave-front estimator unimplemented.
entries.relations: Extends OE-03 (negative exploratory result refined with 3 predeclared groups; OE-03 proposal observation requirements refined); read-only coordination with the selector mechanics task (untouched); refines OQ-3's observation ladder with literature grounding.
must_not_infer: observation insufficiency from a low-power negative comparison
metastability or hidden-state causation from descriptive contrasts
production thresholds or controller selection from this diagnostic
wave-front observations as directly measured facts

entries.results: (1) REUSE AUDIT: combined causal observation histories were never tested for entry benefit - closest priors are OE-04 (univariate only, per-feature subsets, service-only target), OE-03 (single feature), SW-10 L1' (IDM actuator/baseline; +0.160 [-0.014,+0.328] does not transfer), PPO wall_ppo/1 (policy learning, converged always-activate, 98.4% feasibility-determined, LEAK_pre600 cohort binding - no predictive mapping estimated). (2) CORR-20: OE-04's negative holds for univariate linear fits of individual features on their own complete-case subsets against a per-subset observed-regime constant, service target only; the '3-group contract fails' reading was never tested and is superseded; the comparator is an observation-based rule, not the nominal demand class (DEV/OE02 nominal-m2700 cells split across both regimes). (3) JOINT COMPARISON (the one missing offline test, now closed): ridge MAE 8.571 vs univariate 6.050 vs regime constant 6.043 vs global 6.397 on y_service (ridge beats regime on 4/13); effort 3.079 vs 3.094 (tie; global 2.992 lowest); TTC 0.170 vs 0.108 - NEGATIVE at the joint level within 8-group power; the joint model is unstable at this n (e.g. +11.3 where y=-9.8). (4) DECISION: no further offline fitting on the current 14 cells is admissible (would re-sample the same noise); the only remaining path to an observation-to-benefit answer is OE-03's fixed-sample entry study (4121-4132, 57,600 s, NOT authorized), with the pre-registered future feature contract joint-and-compact; >=2 qualifying cells justify predictor fitting (fit 4121-4128, evaluate 4129-4132); 0 qualifying cells close the fixed-maneuver entry family at this demand/penetration and move the route to a different mechanism/state (owner decision).

entries.limitations: 13 cells / 8 held-out groups; only several-s/req effects detectable; intent-to-treat labels mix 8 complete and 5 aborted/partial deliveries by design; single beneficial label (4117) forbids any classification claim; alpha not tuned (by protocol); ridge instability at this n is itself informative, not a defect to search away.

any benefit prediction or qualifying-action selection from service MAE numbers
that the 4119/4120 negative service differences indicate beneficial cells (both harmful under the joint criteria)
transfer of SW-10 or CFG efficacy claims to the CIRCLES actuator
authorization of any simulation from this analysis

entries.results: (1) PHYSICAL (ITT): first current-era multi-realization evidence that the fixed entry CAN qualify: 3/9 executed arms beneficial (4125 dev: service -31.176, braking -0.0281, effort -4.292, TTC -0.2468, wait -0.0032, 0 collisions; 4129 eval: qualifying via braking -0.2498 + effort -10.463 + TTC -0.3647 with service +0.260 within allowance and 0 collisions; 4132 eval: service -15.076 with all five costs improving, 0 collisions); 6/9 harmful (4121 effort/TTC; 4123 effort +10.165 + 2 collisions despite service -28.824; 4124 TTC + 2 collisions; 4126 6 collisions + pre-HOLD abort; 4127 service +10.965 + 2 collisions); 3 cohort refusals (25% of scenarios) retain damping. Qualifying rate 3/9 = 0.333, exact 95% CI 0.0749-0.7007 (n=9, wide); ITT 3/12 = 0.25. All three beneficial arms have zero treatment collisions; divergences between service and the joint criteria are large (4123 vs 4125). (2) PREDICTION (frozen protocol, exploratory): development LOSO - model does not beat the constants (service MAE 17.33 vs 15.91); held-out (3 cells) - model MAE 9.20 vs regime 6.66 vs global 6.66, model beats regime on 2/3 cells (s4132 accurate at 1.35 err; s4129 missed by 23.5: predicted -23.3, actual +0.26). Benefits vary strongly; the frozen single-snapshot feature set does not estimate them better than constants at this sample size.

No field study demonstrates CAV-pacing throughput gain (service/wave/energy endpoints only); no JAD field test exists; German AFB trial NOT FOUND (unconfirmed). Wall-v2 contract: entry gate E1 demand + E2 refuse-while-near-merge-slow-reporters-at-crawl + E3 speed floor ~9 m/s + E4 hysteresis/dwell; gradual-buffer assembly with conservative fail-closed abort; near-merge compact hold; taper with outflow capped below merge capacity; blended native handover; fail-closed native release. entries.name: Density-vs-reconstruction correlation: report mass predicts whole-field error, not merge-zone error
entries.question: Does the amount of CAV reporting change reconstruction quality, and can report density serve as an uncertainty label for the reconstructor?
entries.controller: n/a (offline inference of the retained WM-04 v1 checkpoint; no training, no simulation)
entries.baseline_cf: None (correlational analysis; quartile and AUC contrasts on one model)
entries.scenario: WM-03 holdout features deduplicated to the independent (seed,tick) unit: seeds 7011/7012, both m2700, n=1082; merge zone defined as d2m in [-100,+400) m (bins 10-19), far mainline >= +400 m
entries.seeds_splits: Holdout seeds only (7011/7012); no acceptance access
entries.observation_contract: Online-legal observables derived from report features only: reports/60s, reports/last10s, active seconds, closest report approach to merge (30 s), spatial span. Truth used only as the error target and confound diagnostics

entries.changed_vars: None (analysis)
entries.fixed_vars: WM-04 v1 checkpoint and WM-03 holdout features as-is
entries.comparators: Pooled and within-run Spearman/Pearson of error vs density observables; quartile error tables; AUC of density flagging top error quartile; head-disagreement informativeness check
entries.matching_reuse: Reuses WM-03 dataset v1 and WM-04 v1 checkpoint; zero new evidence generation
entries.requested_vs_delivered: Owner question (does CAV amount change reconstruction odds; usable as uncertainty label) answered for the whole field and separately for the merge zone
entries.budget_actual: 0s simulation; one CPU inference pass over 1,082 examples
entries.results: WHOLE FIELD: pooled Spearman best-of-5 occupied-bin RMSE vs reports/60s -0.39 (uniform-mean-head field -0.92; within-seed -0.77 for 7011, -0.17 for 7012, sign-consistent); sparsest report quartile mean error 7.36 m/s (p90 10.16) vs 4.6-5.3 (p90 5.2-6.3) for the rest; AUC of low report count flagging the top error quartile 0.77 pooled (0.91 within 7011), combined with merge proximity 0.74. MERGE ZONE: not predicted - pooled rho +0.003 (reports) / +0.092 (closest approach), within-run inconsistent, AUC 0.62-0.64. SPREAD ANTI-INFORMATIVE: head disagreement correlates +0.63 with density and flags high error at AUC 0.14 (inverted). Merge-report absence in last 30 s: 0% of normal-error vs 11.1% of top-error samples. CONFOUNDS: reports/60s vs true vehicle count 0.89, vs true occupied mean speed -0.91 (density ~= congestion)
entries.criteria_verdict: Report density is usable as a coarse, online-legal, transparent evidence-mass uncertainty for the FULL state (fail-closed bands), and merge-report absence as a red flag; density is NOT merge-zone confidence - merge protection requires localized observables (per-bucket merge-zone report counts in the v2 featurizer, closest-approach/presence now). Spread confirmed unusable as uncertainty
entries.limitations: Two independent trajectories, both m2700 (no demand-regime diversity); within-run autocorrelation, descriptive statistics only; v1 checkpoint whose holdout was used for v1/v2 selection (mild selection bias, documented in WM-04); congestion/sensor-count confound inseparable in this corpus; thresholds regime-specific and require recalibration plus a fresh holdout before any confirmatory claim
entries.relations: Consumes WM-03 dataset and WM-04 v1 checkpoint; refines WM-01 coverage findings for the trained model; informs admission-gate uncertainty inputs and the stage-2 v2 featurization (localized merge-zone report features)
must_not_infer: Demand-regime-general density thresholds
Merge-zone confidence from global report density
Calibrated probabilities from density bands or head spread

structured.scientific_verdict: Density strongly predicts whole-field reconstruction error but not merge-zone error; usable as coarse full-field evidence-mass uncertainty and fail-closed gate input, not as merge confidence; head spread anti-informative

entries.changed_vars: Two changes only: (1) speed regression loss now masked to occupied cells (counts > 0) instead of all 240 cells; (2) per-head per-cell bias (240 x 5 params) initialized to train per-cell mean occupied speed. Encoder (GRU 64), best-of-5 heads, gate, spread regularizer, data, dedup, splits unchanged from v3
entries.fixed_vars: Everything else; identical holdout (15 unique runs, 8115 examples); identical baselines (report-persistence, climatology, global mean) computed on the same occupied mask

entries.results: DIAGNOSIS (v3): pooled occupied RMSE 11.85 m/s vs persistence 4.66 and climatology 6.75 - the trained model was 2.5x WORSE than copying the last report; occupied-cell bias -10.10 m/s; ramp group worst (14.9); correlation 0.36-0.55. Cause: unmasked speed loss over ~67% empty cells (target 0) rewards hedging to zero; plus rank-64 linear heads cannot carry 240 per-cell priors. FIX (v4): first-epoch holdout RMSE 2.43; final pooled 3.28 (beats persistence by 30%), bias +0.70, correlation 0.84-0.91, worst ramp cell 4.60, merge-zone 2.74-5.42. GATES on v4: Gate1 PASS (hit10 1.000, hit5 0.848, cell RMSE 2.94), Gate2 PASS improved (reweight top=best 0.642), Gate3 FAIL unchanged (spread AUC 0.339; heads now accurate and nearly agree, spread 1.5 - architectural item stands). REHEARSAL with v4 reconstructor: R1 hit10 1.0; dynamics unchanged PASS; selector closed-loop regret now +9.13 mean (7012 +26.05, picks pi 96%) - reconstruction fix UNMASKED the selector as the binding constraint: even oracle-state selection on 7012 has +9.93 regret, and the trivial always-native policy scores +0.38 mean holdout regret vs the learned selector's +9.13 (24x better). Verdict: reconstruction FIXED; closed-loop selection remains NO-GO; current evidence supports native-as-default policy

entries.question: For each supported controller (native IDM release, retained CIRCLES damping, PI-external-U, FollowerStopper candidate, moving-wall family): in which traffic states x objectives x information regimes does it actually benefit, where is it neutral, where harmful - and how should benefit be categorized so the label is consistent across tracks and meaningful for switching decisions?

entries.comparators: Per-controller five-cost contrasts already registered: native-vs-retain and PI-vs-retain/native (CV-17/19/30), FS-vs-native/retain (CV-06), wall-vs-damping executed arms (OE-59/60/62/63/65/69/70, WL-04 harness)
entries.matching_reuse: Full reuse of executed evidence; literature re-verified from primary sources where reachable (Stern 2018 equations/parameters, Chou 2021, Milanes/Shladover records, FLOW controller inventory, IDM sources); unverifiable items flagged UNVERIFIED

entries.attempts: No simulator launch; zero-simulation analysis (6 research subreports, all preserved)
entries.results: Key findings. (1) Native IDM wins service 9/9 shared-prefix cells, all-five 7/9, TTC 9/9, zero native-arm collisions ever; actuated arms are coverage-limited (18-47 percent leaderless release) and one-sidedly lossy at delivery (PI undershoot 60-97 percent of endpoints; FS positive-accel MAE 1.16-1.34 m/s; damping 6.6-18.3 percent below). (2) Retained damping: dominated at high demand (native-minus-retain service -1.0..-1.6 at m2000, -10.2..-23.8 s/req all-five x3 at m2700, CV-30), best-suffix in 0/11 stage-1 cells, two unexplained 4-collision damping-arm events (CUR-04 4107/m2700-class, stage-1 7009); remaining roles = frozen reference instrument + determinism anchor. (3) PI: beats retained damping all-five 4/6 CV-30 cells, never beats native all-five (0/6); reproducible partial wins are effort/smoothing (3/6) and 7303-class service; strictly between native and damping on all five (CV-17); unexplained same-load service sign flip (+23.7/-29.2, 4107/4108) is the largest selection epistemic gap. (4) FollowerStopper: close-leader speed-cap braking specialist; literature window (slow covered leader + wave state + wave-matched U, Stern 2018 U=7.5 m/s ring result; Chou 2021 time-headway unsafety at highway speed) unreachable under fixed road-limit U=31.29; local full-horizon negative-vs-native (CV-06, +36.25 s/req at m2700). (5) Wall: state-conditioned metering device; four-joint beneficial window (discharge-inflection entry at >= capacity demand with zero near-merge slow reporters; near-merge compact hold; hold until storage drains; tapered capped-outflow exit); every executed in-window entry gained (-23.14, -11.30 s/req; WL-04 harness -30.2 s/veh), every executed mid-crawl entry harmed (+1.0..+32.88); K1 gate B qualifies 4/30 and gate C 2/30, with two shared qualifiers (OE-70); wall-v2 E1-E5 refuses all executed harmful AND the historical beneficial K1 entry (WL-02 envelope disjointness); wall-v2 beneficial window has harness-only evidence (WL-04). (6) Categorization: four incompatible yardsticks coexist (OE gate, CV descriptive, stage-1 service-only argmin, WM-09 regret); 12 of 29 recorded HARMFUL contrasts have service improving; 7003 five-way improvement labeled NONBENEFICIAL; 7304 gate-BENEFICIAL-vs-retain yet loses 17.9 s/req vs native. Recommendation: Option B five-category Pareto taxonomy immediately (recompute over 57 recorded contrasts: 28 DOMINANT / 4 TRADE-OFF / 2 MIXED-NEUTRAL / 13 GUARDRAIL-HARM / 10 SERVICE-HARM), Option C switching-regret as the declared decision estimand with abstention default, Option A 2-seed replication as the action gate (under which all current per-cell labels are honestly UNRATED). Bounded open-question inventory in REPORT.md section 4.
entries.criteria_verdict: Analysis complete; no controller accepted/rejected/deployed/switched; categorization redesigns are proposals requiring owner adoption; wall assembly still requires feasibility AND incremental-benefit approval per AGENTS.md
entries.limitations: Single-seed status of nearly all quoted cells (flags throughout); CV-30 full-horizon prefix dilution unquantified; literature items marked UNVERIFIED in the reports (CIRCLES field percentages, ACC/CACC PI structure claims, standalone Wu FollowerStopper paper not located); agent-written reports spot-checked by the integrator against the primary JSON/report sources for headline numbers, not line-by-line re-derived
entries.must_not_infer: No new physical efficacy claim; no controller superiority, generalization or switching claim; native-win statements are descriptive over registered single-seed cells, not a validated selection rule; the wall beneficial-window characterization does not authorize any wall assembly; taxonomy adoption does not retroactively alter frozen OE-era labels

entries.name: Selector generalization test on the enlarged corpus: negative; plus first pipeline-verified wall labels (CV-31/32)
entries.question: Does selector generalization by traffic state (rather than cell identity) emerge once the corpus gains fresh congested cells with opposite winners (7531 PI vs 7534 native), a new mid-demand regime (m2400, incl. the first retain-best cell), and 5 pipeline-verified wall labels?
entries.changed_vars: Corpus +15 accepted arms (CV-31) + 5 layered-verified wall arms (CV-32); selector retrained on 20 cells / 4 regimes; holdout extended with fresh never-trained cells 7534 (m2700) and 7536 (m2400)
entries.fixed_vars: v4 reconstructor unchanged; dynamics retrained on enlarged corpus; margins weighting; holdout seeds 7011/7012/7101 untouched
entries.comparators: Closed-loop (reconstructed-state) and oracle-state selector regret vs cell-best arm; always-native policy baseline; wall-vs-{retain,native,pi} per-cell contrasts
entries.seeds_splits: Train: 20 cells incl. 7531/7532/7535. Holdout: 7011, 7012, 7101, 7102, 7534, 7536. No acceptance access
entries.results: NEGATIVE for selector generalization: fresh never-trained congested cell 7534 (native best by 7.8 s/veh) picked PI on 90.6% of windows (+7.61 s/veh closed-loop regret); 7012 unchanged (+25.16); only the near-tie fresh m2400 cell improved (7536 +1.39). With 20 cells across 3 regimes the selector transfers the same 'congested -> PI' rule, and oracle-state selection on 7534 still carries +3.46 regret - the native-vs-PI moderator is NOT identifiable from the current lane-split state features at this scale. More same-kind seeds is therefore RULED OUT as the fix; the registered next step is moderator identification (what physically distinguishes 7007/7531-class from 7012/7534-class cells) before further seed spend. Always-native remains the correct deployment policy (+0.38 s/veh mean holdout regret vs selector +7.14). WALL (CV-32, layered tier, zero collisions): fully engaged at 7531 (two episodes) and LOST to all three controllers (+6.0/+7.2/+11.0); neutral where it engaged once (7532, 7536) or failed to reach hold (7534); gate correctly SUPPRESSED entry at 7535 (29 dwell checks, 0 entries) where retain was best. Wall never beat a cell's best controller; it also never hurt relative to retained damping.
entries.criteria_verdict: Selector: NO-GO for deployment, now attributable to moderator non-identifiability rather than label scarcity. Wall: verified operable and safe, no benefit evidence

entries.name: Rollout verification: autonomous iteration error + score-based (world-model-outcome) selection prototype
entries.question: Per the owner's architecture directive: how much error does the world model accumulate when it iterates on its own predictions (autoregressive rollout) vs fed true states, and can choosing a controller by scoring each arm's imagined future (predicted flow over the rollout horizon) replace the outcome-supervised selector?
entries.changed_vars: Selection mechanism replaced: no outcome-supervised chooser at decision time; each candidate arm is rolled out H=60 s by the dynamics ensemble from the cell's state and scored by predicted mean occupied speed (transparent flow score); argmax flow picks
entries.fixed_vars: v4 reconstructor; dynamics architecture (3-member MLP ensemble, delta parameterization); featurization; holdout cells incl. fresh 7534/7536
entries.comparators: Autoregressive vs open-loop one-step vs persistence RMSE on (a) turnover mask and (b) fixed occupied mask (isolates speed skill from occupancy turnover); score-based picks vs measured best arm per cell; always-native policy; horizon sensitivity (h10 vs h60); two dynamics objective variants (masked + persistence-anchored) tested against the unmasked baseline
entries.seeds_splits: Holdout runs only (7011, 7012, 7101, 7102, 7534, 7536 + wall 7012); train cells untouched
entries.results: Q1 ITERATE-ON-OWN: fixed-mask one-step error 9.0 m/s vs persistence 1.1 - the dynamics is 8x WORSE than copying at one step because the 50 m-cell state carries no intra-cell position, so next-second cell transitions are not predictable from it (representation ceiling, not a loss bug). Autonomous iteration compounds: +0.9 m/s @10 s, +2.2 @30 s, +4.3 @60 s over open-loop (13.7 vs persistence 3.4 at 60 s fixed-mask). Masked/anchored dynamics variants diverge in rollout (14 to 500+ m/s); the unmasked dynamics is the stablest and was restored. Q2 SCORE-BASED SELECTION: implemented and SAFE - mean closed-loop regret +0.298 s/veh (always-native +0.23; supervised selector +7.14), correct on 7012 and 7534 (the supervised selector's failure cells), wrong only on the near-tie 7536 (+1.49). BUT the picks flip with horizon (h10 fails 7012/7534) and the imagined future is worse than copying, so the wins are NOT yet attributable to the world model's future - the score is largely reading the present reconstructed state. Verdict: the owner's structure is viable and safe but currently adds nothing over the present state; making it real requires intra-cell positional detail in the state (refeaturizable from EXISTING telemetry at finer bins - zero new simulation), then re-running this exact verification.
entries.criteria_verdict: Score-based selection: GO as a safe policy skeleton (never worse than near-native in this test); autonomous-rollout advantage: NOT YET - blocked on state representation, with a zero-simulation path registered
entries.requested_vs_delivered: Delivered: rollout error curves (3 objectives tested), divergence horizons, flow-score selection with start-state ablation and horizon sensitivity, always-native comparison
entries.limitations: Markov assumption on a position-free state; flow score is a proxy for the registered per-request cost; 5 multi-arm holdout cells; single rollout horizon family; dynamics ensemble member spread not yet used as confidence
must_not_infer: World-model rollouts currently add planning value
Masked dynamics objective is better (it diverges)
Wall selectable (single-cell dynamics support)
Flow score equals registered cost

entries.question: Per the owner's architecture (outcome-scored planning, per-CAV assignment, wall as committed episodes): can each component be rebuilt on existing evidence with acceptance evidence, and does the assembled planner choose better than always-native?
entries.changed_vars: Six builds: dataset v2 (+RSU ramp events, 88 runs); fine-grid field dynamics (REJECTED); per-vehicle dynamics (PASSED gate); post-switch arm-aware dynamics (identifiability PASS); reconstructor v5 5-member ensemble with RSU inputs (Gate 1 improved, Gate 3 still fail with root cause identified); planner prototype with reachability mask, wall lock, 600 s scoring, tie->native rule; dispatcher module (13 tests); wall history/current-gen audits

entries.results: PER-COMPONENT: (1) fine-grid field dynamics REJECTED - in-sample failure proves field states lack per-vehicle information (both 50 m and 10 m); (2) per-vehicle car-following dynamics PASSED (one-step 2.17 vs 2.33 advected persistence; 60-step rollout bounded); (3) post-switch arm-aware dynamics: controller identity is INFORMATIVE (0.1228 vs 0.1364 m/s, 19/21 runs, p=0.0002; 2.32M pairs); (4) reconstructor v5 BEATS v4 on every stored metric (hit5 0.945, RMSE 2.27, ramp 1.55 via the owner's RSU ramp sensor - ablation-proven -39%); ensemble spread now HONEST (r=0.368 with error) but Gate 3 still fails (AUC 0.492) with root cause identified: degenerate coverage input in the spread regularizer; (5) horizon study: 60 s scoring NOT sufficient (top-1 0.56 vs 0.72-0.76 at 600 s; deterministic sims -> systematic bias; median cell margin 0.96 << 4.9 s resolvable at 60 s); (6) planner prototype: SAFE but NOT ADDITIVE - raw imagined argmax mis-ranks (18/54 holdout recovery, regret 6.75; the learned dynamics' margins do not transfer like the perfect-model study); the owner's tie rule (<0.9 m/s -> native) recovers exactly always-native performance (45/54, regret 0.19; fleet-level 0.534 vs 0.509); stability achieved (0.47% decision flips at 1 Hz); 30,566 labeled decisions generated for a future learned proposer; (7) wall data: history multiplies episodes ~30x (era-tagged), current-gen wall-v2 engagement remains 380 vehicle-seconds; assembly dv unlearnable without command/owner inputs; Phase-B wall matrix specified (12 runs); (8) dispatcher built and unit-tested (13 tests), wall-subset execution a documented stub pending a subset-roster wall session
entries.criteria_verdict: Every component now has acceptance evidence. The deployed policy remains always-native (planner with tie rule = native-equivalent, never worse). The score-based chooser's remaining blockers are, in order: (a) learned-dynamics margin trustworthiness (needs Phase-B mixed-assignment runs), (b) Gate 3 coverage-input fix (one-line, next training), (c) wall command-aware features + Phase-B wall runs
entries.requested_vs_delivered: Owner-directed Phase A: all 8 workstreams delivered (6 by parallel subagents) with per-component gates
entries.limitations: Per-CAV arm effects remain second-order until Phase-B mixed runs; heterogeneity scores are extrapolation; flow-proxy fails 7305 at all horizons; ensemble Gate 3 fix untested; planner margins thin (0.014 m/s mean) though stable
must_not_infer: Planner adds value today over always-native
Per-CAV effects validated
Wall predictable from current features
Gate 3 solved

entries.results: COUNTING AUDIT: independent counter vs eval = 2174/2240 rows equal under the physical-row cohort rule, 66 rows eval-higher (+47 merge, +8 disc_left, +11 disc_right) ALL from vehicles junction-internal at window start that the eval's retro-fix tracks at their destination s0; with the matched (destination) cohort rule 2240/2240 equal -> class (ii), fixed (tracked_state inj_at + NativeLog.inj + 5 regression tests); post-fix A2 re-run moves the headline negligibly (disc t 443->442 @H10), so the residual is real. Truth event census: 1->0 2409, 0->1 1222, 2->1 2120, no other class; 100% of physical events carry SUMO lane_changed (the raw flag also fires on ~44.6k junction-internal transitions and is not a valid LC definition). DECOMPOSITION: disc surplus 6.71x leftward, 3.68x rightward (5.7x aggregate); pred 2436 vs truth 1049 events in the first 10 s of identical initial states (2.32x floor); pred events cluster in its own congestion (n3+/n6+ 48% vs 5%); repeat changers 1203 pred vs 119 truth; change-back within 10 s 5.7% vs 1.8%; merges: pred dwell median 34.5 s vs truth 12 s, pred merges late on the edge (7.5% below s=415 vs 22.4%), pred never dead-stops (truth 48 stops at the dead end, junction-rescued). ABLATIONS (descriptive, NOT adopted): politeness 0.2 triples disc churn (40.5/window) and quadruples ping-pong; politeness 1.0 -1.4%; symmetric (bias 0) +75% leftward; threshold 0.3 -20% only; urgency onset immaterial (merge gating is kinematic safe-gaps: foll_bsafe 53k, lead_headway 28.8k rejected candidates). No tested parameter approaches truth (2.64 disc/window). ATTRIBUTION: (i) none found (trace-engine assertions: every accepted decision's re-derived terms equal the engine's decision); (ii) the mid-junction tracked-start convention, ~1.5-2% of truth events, FIXED with tests; (iii) DOMINANT for disc (the 2.32x matched-state floor = MOBIL semantics under 0.5 s ballistic integration: no maneuver time/hysteresis/strategic preference) and for merge lag (strict kinematic safe-gaps + ego-gain vs SUMO LC2013 strategic early merging and dead-end rescue); (iv) divergence amplification from 2.32x to 5.7x (model's own congestion; free-road truncation, no arrivals), roughly the remaining ~60% of the surplus. ANSWERS: yes NEXT: Owner options: (1) keep the textbook model and make C4L1 (b) reported-only; (2) approve a separately registered structural addition (lane-hold hysteresis, strategic early-merge incentive, or anticipation/lateral dynamics); (3) parameter change on TRAIN evidence (not recommended: best single change removes only ~20%). Delay scope unchanged: Part A tracked-scope, Part B carries untracked arrivals (owner decision (c)).

cross_cutting_corrections: COUNTING: 'seven delivered wall traces' (wall_harm_speed PART5/REPORT, docs/ROUTE.md) = SEVEN distinct physical traces but SIX delivered walls + ONE refusal (B4108 executed no wall; exact damping match). C4107 is exact B4107 reuse. Labels: 5 harmful delivered, 1 nonbeneficial delivered, 1 nonbeneficial refusal; 2 independent seed groups. Earlier eras: natural panel '8 attempts / 5 delivered' and later 'six delivered walls' (OBSERVATION_DECISION_CONTRACT, incl. gentle 4107) are both era-correct - never mix counting bases.

NEUTRALITY: the uncapped-target 4108 wall is NEARLY NEUTRAL in aggregate (net -0.5 vehicle-second across 1,307 vehicles; per-request cost differences |d| <= 0.0011) but NOT an exact no-op: 2 vehicles differ by +/-75.5 s, effort +1.44 total across 665 vehicles, TTC +1.0 on 5. Sign-corrected cost differences (treatment - damping): service -0.000383 (slight improvement), braking -0.000765 (slight improvement), effort +0.001100 (worse), TTC +0.000765 (worse); strict joint non-deterioration FAILS (effort and TTC worsen) while the guardrailed label stays nonbeneficial. PART5's 'meets strict joint non-deterioration' and REPORT's 'physical no-op' are withdrawn by this reconciliation.

SIGNS: PART5's results table mixes conventions - the 4108 row and the 4107 source-wait cell display improvements-convention values under a 'treatment cost - damping cost' header. Always re-derive from runs/active/target_speed_v1/analysis.json before quoting signs.

TRACE-SCOPE: 'seven distinct full-horizon executions' (PART5/REPORT/ROUTE harm-localization paragraph) refers to the lifecycle/cohort/duration/entry-target SUBSET (B4107, B4108-refusal, C4108, D4107-H5, D4108-H5, T4107, T4108), NOT to every CIRCLES-era experiment: the natural-panel attempts (8), gentle-wall completion episodes (2) and brake/HOLD cells (12) are separate CIRCLES-era physical traces outside that count. The cross-era delivered count 'six walls + one refusal' swaps gentle-4107 for the refusal inside the delivered set; always name the subset when quoting a count.

MONOTONICITY: two target settings on two exposed seeds cannot establish a monotone dose law, uncontrollability of the 4107 attractor, or observation insufficiency; the entry-target comparison changes assembly AND handback together with maintained speed (full-maneuver contrast, never a pure slowdown-depth effect).

BUDGET ARITHMETIC: target-speed block 120+120+2400+2400 = 5,040 s used of the 9,840 s ceiling (2 mechanics + 4 episode slots); PART5's '1 mechanics fixture slot and 2 episode slots remain' contradicts its own 'Budget remaining: 1 episode slot' - correct remainder is 4,800 s = 2 episode slots, 0 mechanics slots. Protocol planned 4,920 s; the extra 120 s is the disclosed TH-05 charged failure. Lifecycle A-D: 120x4 + 2,400x5 = 12,480 s. Brake/HOLD: 240 + 19,200 = 19,440 s fully consumed. Escalation-execution scope: 49 allocations, 56,089.5 s actual vs 56,360.0 s horizons. The 12,480 and 19,440 blocks are separately registered; no document sums them.

RE-VERIFICATION vs NEW PHYSICAL RUNS: gentle_wall_v1 logger failure resolved by metadata-only repair + tests (no new physics) THEN a new authorized 4,800 s block; target-speed corridor STOP resolved by zero-simulation re-verification (verification_resolution.json); TH-06 criterion failure corrected by offline law recomputation; brake_hold aggregate comparison resolved by tolerance re-check; formation v2 failures resolved by NEW physical fixtures (v3); adoption runner-smoke role guard resolved by metadata (0 s).

NOMINAL vs DELIVERED: brake_hold H40 nominal never delivered (actual 27/31 s); B3 delivered 8 s actual HOLD vs 20 s nominal; 4108 gentle never reached HOLD; natural-panel 4108 arms aborted at/before readiness; sustained-wall W_HOLD/W_ORACLE cap semantics (absolute step) made 'hard max 900 s' a 650 s hold (self-declared).

INVALID vs VALID NEGATIVE: gentle_wall_v1 corridor (logger crash, zero wall commands) and B2 developing_constraint (insertion impossible) are INVALID blocks; the natural panel, brake/HOLD factorial, lifecycle A-D, dissolution, and gentle completion are VALID negatives. escalation-v2 300-case dataset is INVALID as efficacy evidence (dose failure: mean delivered ~4 s of requested 30 s) though valid as a dose audit.

REFUSALS: B4108 refusal (lifecycle_entry:remaining_maneuver_exceeds_map_boundary) and the gentle 4108 abort are NOT executed walls; a refusal exactly matching damping (all five paired differences exactly 0) is not a benefit label.

SEED GROUPS vs CELLS: brake/HOLD 12 cells = 2 independent seed groups (three strong 4108 runs realize one command trajectory; 4108 b03 cells are one trajectory); N30 = 10 seed groups; the 178-decision penetration grid = 12 seeds; 300 escalation-v2 cases = 100 seed groups; sustained-wall stages use 30 seeds/cell with digest-verified reuse (C4107 = B4107 exactly).

EXACT EQUIVALENCE vs SMALL DIFFERENCES: R1 was digest-identical to W_HOLD on 120/120 (exact, inert by construction); R1b outcome-identical to W_ORACLE 'to the cent'; B4108 refusal exactly matched damping; the uncapped 4108 wall is NOT exactly damping (small nonzero differences above).

MOVING-WALL vs FIXED-BAND METERING: the current evidence base is the CIRCLES-era cohort moving wall (CUR/LC/TH). The sustained-wall program (SW) is a band-passage actuator on IDM; the v4-v5.8 line (W5) is a latched-cohort compact wall on IDM/Krauss; LEG-07 is band metering + supervisors. No number transfers across these actuator/baseline combinations; historical metering gains do not validate the current moving formation.

DEVELOPMENT vs HELD-OUT: everything in SW/W5/CFG/DEC/LEG is development evidence. The only prospective-style physical tests ever run are DEC-04's rule-arm acceptance (FAILED on 4201-4220) and nothing else; Part G prospective efficacy, gate validation (4601-4660) and final paper seeds (5001-5060) remain sealed/unexecuted.

DENOMINATOR AND PROSE DRIFT (archived, self-documented): terminal-speed '75% below the frozen 80%' denominator mismatch (W5-04); PREP3 '5 prevented' vs table '8/3' (SW-04); 2200 control delay 12.43 vs 12.44 s/veh (SW-02/06); T880 taper convenience field zero vs authoritative five steps (W5-11, documented in-doc); margin law v1 vs degenerate 32% LOO refit (LEG-06); timing '28 vs 18 cells' typo and the corrected -0.070 LOO (DEC-05, documented); handback speed-equality correction with later paired physical check (ND-05/06, documented); escalation evidence_audit's pre-freeze 'TTC allowance 0' proposal vs the frozen 0.02 margin actually applied (CUR-09).

ARCHIVE-VERIFICATION PRECISION: adoption-time archive verification (output/adoption_cleanup/archive_verification.json) performed ONE complete post-suite SHA256 scan of all 59,846 original files, then exact restoration + targeted SHA256 re-verification of its sole mismatch ('No new full data scan is claimed', per its reconciliation.method). Later era checks (e.g. the brake-hold-era verification --archive pass) traversed manifest entries with hashes_checked=0: path/manifest identity checks, NOT rehashes. Path/manifest checks and content hashes are different evidence levels; quote the right one.

MECHANISM EVIDENCE LEVELS: distinguish measured effects (registered paired differences), temporal localization (window analyses), plausible mechanisms (queue/lane-allocation narratives consistent with traces - e.g. the 637.5 s cascade is a geometry-consistent explanation, not an internal proof) and experimentally isolated causes (sham / assembly-only / same-prefix continuation arms). Failed historical prediction studies (CFG, DEC, W5-10) do NOT prove CAV-observation insufficiency under every controller or action space; they invalidate the tested feature/action combinations on their populations.

CONTINUATION SIGNS (CORR-6): REPORT_V2.md and PART3_RESULTS_V2.md display the 4107 raise-26 effort and source-wait cells with inverted signs (+5.745 / +0.134 'worse'; label 'effort, TTC, wait'). The registered analysis (improvements = control - treatment) gives cost differences effort -5.745149 and wait -0.133569 - both IMPROVE - and violated_guardrails is ['ttc_seconds_per_request'] only. TTC_GROUND_TRUTH_V3 (finalized audit) states the same. The v2 dataset rows were already correct. Quote raise-arm signs only from the registered analysis or the audit's ground truth.

MAINTAINED-SPEED ISOLATION (CORR-7): the ENTRY-target comparison (TH-07) changed assembly and handback together with maintained speed - that qualification stands for the entry frame. The CONTINUATION arms (TA-01 lower-22, TA-03 raise-26) varied maintained speed at FIXED pre-branch history, entry/assembly timing and scheduled end, so an unqualified 'speed has never been isolated' claim is retired: maintained speed is isolated within the continuation frame on these two exposed seed groups (still no dose law, no qualifying action).

TTC SEQUENCE VERSIONS (CORR-9): maintenance 2 incorporated the then-current v3 audit as final; v3 is now superseded (phase contamination, withdrawn '4-9 s' warning, W1 mislabel), v4 stands for phase + withdrawals, v5's evaluator is superseded by v6 (8 defects), and v6 is execution-complete with report/spec/tests pending. Per-file statuses in artifact_review; quote only artifact_review 'current' items.

RELATED PRIOR OUTCOME (CORR-10): the 4107 raise-26 continuation (TA-03) and the natural-panel 4107/m2700/t600 wall (CUR-09) have near-identical aggregate cost differences vs damping (service -8.4357 vs -8.4205 s/req; TTC +0.0396 vs +0.0399; identical source wait). Cross-linked as related_prior_outcome. Similar aggregate metrics do not establish trajectory equivalence; controller/lifecycle differences remain material; consult prior mechanism evidence (TH-01 cascade family) before claiming novelty.

conventions.cost_difference: cost difference = treatment cost - reference cost; NEGATIVE = improvement (used in all structured records). Where a source stores 'improvements' it is control - treatment = -(cost difference); every structured outcome asserts improvement == -cost_difference.

decision_frames.entry_vs_policy: proposed wall versus continued damping from the pre-decision state (the overall-policy benchmark)
decision_frames.continuation: keep / adjust / release from the SAME executed wall history after assembly (same-prefix contrasts). A better continuation does not justify the original entry decision; damping-from-beginning is not an action available after assembly.
decision_frames.continuation_vs_policy_benchmark: a continuation action (keep/adjust/release from an executed wall history) scored against damping-from-the-beginning: an overall-policy benchmark, NOT an available action after assembly

evidence_kinds.measured_effect: registered paired outcome difference from executed runs
evidence_kinds.temporal_localization: when/where within a trace a measured difference arises (window/partition analyses)
evidence_kinds.plausible_mechanism: geometry/queue narrative consistent with traces but not experimentally isolated (flagged per entry)
evidence_kinds.experimentally_isolated_cause: cause isolated by an intervention on the same prefix (sham/assembly-only/continuation arms)

conventions.observation_ladder_status: As of the cutoff, acquired reports reach implemented/descriptive/feasibility and are outcome-associated descriptively; NOTHING reaches action_validated (zero positive labels). Retrospective full-state diagnostics are not automatically CAV-acquired features; future measurements cannot be predecision features.

budget_model.allocated_charged: allocation records opened (failed allocations stay charged)
budget_model.actual_progress: SUMO seconds actually simulated (may be < charged, e.g. crashed jobs)
budget_model.completed_episodes: arms reaching full horizon with checks
budget_model.zero_sim_reverification: checks re-run on immutable artifacts with 0 new simulation (never a new physical sample)
budget_model.non_additivity: campaign totals are NOT summed across overlapping scopes; totals only where a documented scope exists (e.g. output/escalation_execution/budget_audit.json scope excludes the gentle/lifecycle/brake-hold/target-speed blocks)

evidence_status.consistency_verified: stored arithmetic, relationships and paths validated against the ledger itself (validate command); stored values NOT compared to source contents
evidence_status.source_values_verified: stored costs/differences/verdicts additionally compared field-by-field against the registered source analysis (verify-sources command; report protocols/source_verification_report.json); applies only to registered allowed sources
evidence_status.integrity_receipt_verified: physical/replay integrity attested by an identified receipt (e.g., exact-replay comparison with tolerance 0.0); contents still not independently re-derived by this ledger
evidence_status.report_only_indexed: indexed from historical reports; no structured numeric migration; not re-verified
evidence_status.unknown_or_pending: under correction, awaiting an external audit, or not reviewed

reuse_semantics.canonical_run: the original physical execution; retains its full execution cost (charged and actual seconds) forever
reuse_semantics.alias: a reused reference to a canonical run in another comparison or campaign; zero additional simulation and zero additional charge; carries canonical_run + reuse relationship; never counted as an independent sample
reuse_semantics.new_comparison_cost: only genuinely executed new arms add charged seconds; a replay-verification costs 0 simulation but is still recorded as an event
reuse_semantics.distinctions: exact_reuse (same trajectory replayed/reused bit-identically, manifest-bound) | trace_equivalent (derived outcome identity proven by command-prefix audit) | newly_executed_replay (a fresh physical re-execution verified to match, e.g. observer replays)
reuse_semantics.adoption_budget_scope: the pre-adoption fit-check charge (24,000 s conservative) has no per-run decomposition; left explicit rather than forced into a total

correction_log.claim: OE-04's report and summaries state that 'the predeclared 3-group contract does NOT beat the demand-class constant', which reads as a joint feature-group comparison; 'demand-class' reads as the exogenous demand label; the comparison reads as if scored on a common cell set and as evidence about the wall benefit/risk decision.
correction_log.correction: Verified against compare_features.py/FEATURE_COMPARISON.json: every OE-04 fit is UNIVARIATE (one feature at a time; the 3 groups were never fit jointly - first joint test is OE-05, also negative); the target is the intent-to-treat SERVICE difference only (y_effort/y_ttc stored but unused - not the joint benefit/risk decision); the 'demand-class' constant is an OBSERVED mean-speed regime rule (all_mean_speed_mps >= 25; nominal-m2700 DEV/OE02 cells split across both regimes, e.g. 4118 fast vs 4117 slow); each feature is scored on its OWN complete-case subset (ramp 3/14 cells, bottleneck 10/14) with the benchmark recomputed per subset, so cross-feature MAEs are not directly comparable. OE-04's negative is valid for univariate linear fits of individual features on their own subsets against the per-subset observed-regime constant for the service target; it does not establish joint-group failure, decision unpredictability, or observation insufficiency. Original artifacts preserved unmodified; the joint-level test is recorded in OE-05.

correction_log.claim: OE-05's freeze asserted 'identical proposal in every cell (finite_lifecycle_wall/2, 24 m/s cap rule, H20) ... no cell mixes proposals' and ran its comparison as a test of one wall contract; the OE-05/OE-04/OE-03 framing called the 14 cells 'the 14 causally valid fixed-wall cells'; OE-05 further stated PPO 'learned always-activate', proposed a '>=2 qualifying cells' continuation criterion, and described 4121-4132 as 'fresh'.

Equal target speed and nominal HOLD do not establish equivalent treatments; the damping reference (model sha 762fde07...) IS identical across all cells. OE-05's freeze stop-condition (§7) was therefore satisfied and never evaluated: the saved comparison (arithmetic correct, recomputed from stored predictions within <=5e-4) is retained ONLY as a mixed-controller exploratory analysis and is withdrawn as a one-contract test; OE-03's exploratory fit and OE-04's comparison inherit the same mixed-action interpretive limit (action identities were recorded in DATASET_V2 and dropped in FEATURES_V2). No dataset was restricted and nothing was refitted. Further corrections: PPO's trained actor was deterministically identical to initialization on all 6,716 recorded states (PP-07) - it demonstrated absence of learned selectivity, not a learned always-activate policy; the 4117 fixed-wall beneficial label exists with unproven generalization (OE-02 0/2); two positive labels are neither a prerequisite for continuous fitting nor sufficient for a reliable selector; 4107-4132 are exposed-partition seeds (4119/4120 not fresh; sealed blocks never prospective). Prospective thresholds are owner-owned - no invented positive-count criterion. Manifest: output/entry_observability_v5/COMPATIBILITY_MANIFEST.json.

correction_log.claim: Post-OE-07 next-step framing implied that predicting the physical vector and adding temporal features would be new experimental content, could be read as proposing to learn present-time refusals, presented 3/9 as a population frequency, and left OE-07's budget residue open to misreading as authorization for further pairs.
correction_log.correction: OE-07 already fitted all five continuous-cost models (service, braking, effort, TTC, wait) as secondary targets and already included 30 s/60 s temporal trends in its frozen 13-feature set, so 'predict the physical vector' is not itself a new experiment - the open change is the decision role (joint-criteria screening), the sample and prediction persistence. Current feasibility is already assessed by the causal runtime gate (3 refusals in OE-07); learning present-time refusals is not a benefit-selection task. 3/9 demonstrates that qualifying outcomes exist, with exact 95% CI [0.075, 0.70] - not a precise population frequency. OE-02's negative outcomes remain valid and are supplemented, not superseded. Budget: OE-07 consumed 50,400 of 57,600 s (damping ceiling exactly consumed, 0 unused; 7,200 s wall-category residue); unspent allowance is not authorization and cannot fund a matched pair - any successor requires its own authorization. OE-08 additionally documents the OE-07 access-sequence deviation (all labels materialized before the development fit; split enforced by code path only) and the non-persistence of per-fold development predictions.

correction_log.claim: OE-08's headline ('saved predictions do not support useful beneficial-wall selection'), its noise-vs-allowances finding, its always-wall framing, its missingness note, its access-sequence wording, and its statement that '4133 is the last EXPOSED_CONTROLLER_SEEDS entry' admit materially stronger or factually wrong readings.
correction_log.correction: (1) 'No usable selection information' narrows to: this particular model and this particular screening rule demonstrated no useful selection on three evaluated cases - neither observation-based selection in general nor conjunctive screening in general is refuted. (2) Prediction noise relative to allowances is a plausible limitation of one fixed alpha=1.0 ridge fit on 6 rows, not proof that conjunctive screening is inherently impossible. (3) Always-wall captures benefits AND harms (2 beneficial + 1 harmful on OE-07's held-out cells); coverage alone does not establish superiority, and always-abstaining is not success. (4) All-requested service completion, nominal wall completion (delivered HOLD = H20) and protective early release (4130 18/20; 4126 0/20) are distinct and must be reported separately. (5) Zero missing feature values on 9 cells at one decision time/demand/penetration does not establish complete sensing or eliminate structurally thin p20 ramp coverage. (6) Held-out labels materializing before the fit is an access-control concern: the artifacts establish the model form/procedure were frozen pre-outcome and the fit consumed development rows only (no evidence of leakage into the fitted model) but provide no audit-grade proof the labels were never seen. FACTUAL FIX: EXPOSED_CONTROLLER_SEEDS = range(4107, 4133) = 4107-4132 and ALL 26 are consumed; 4133 is NOT in the registry (OE-08's '4133 is the last exposed entry' is wrong). Consequence: every OE-09 scenario requires an owner seed-allocation decision. OE-08's verified numbers, decision records and screening diagnostic stand unchanged.

correction_log.claim: The OE-11 diagnosis attributed the 95.5 veh-s residual between the presence integral (+6,980) and the registered service difference (+7,075.5) to 'tick edges', described the pre-handback difference as 'exactly zero through handback' without qualification, quoted regional shares (94% pre_merge) against the registered total, and described 4141 as inside the per-feature training range without a joint-support statement.
correction_log.correction: OE-12's accounting verification (exact identity, per-tick records): the residual is the PRE-INSERTION (source-side) term of the exact identity integral(na_w - na_d) = integral(pres_w - pres_d) + integral(ins_d - ins_w): +7,075.5 = +6,980.0 + 95.5 veh-s. The insertion term is corroborated (registered source-wait difference +64.5 veh-s; CAV first-response shifts 12 later / 6 earlier / 264 unchanged, net +6.0 veh-s on CAVs) but not exactly decomposable from saved artifacts (source-wait definition gap + dt=1 s truncation incl. the [2399,2400) tick); the decomposition is APPROXIMATE, bounded at 1.35%. 'Exactly zero through handback' holds for the in-network presence component per tick through t=650 (first divergence t=667); HDV insertion times are not directly observable. Regional percentages are approximate shares of the presence integral. Joint support: 4141's nearest standardized training neighbor is 3.17 (training LOO distances median 2.66, max 5.31; max |z| 1.85) - neither a violation nor a guarantee. Original diagnosis preserved with a correction header.

correction_log.claim: OE-12/CORR-26 framed the 95.5 veh-s identity residual as the 'insertion lag' term (corroborated by source-wait +64.5), described the pre-handback service difference as covered by the per-tick presence records without stating the boundary convention, and recorded the trigger replay as produced by an implementation whose current-bin evaluation used now = t + 1.
correction_log.correction: Three refinements from the OE-13 integrity repair (original artifacts preserved; v1 results unchanged): (1) ACCOUNTING: the defensible decomposition of the registered +7,075.5 veh-s service difference is +6,980.0 sampled in-network presence (offline regional channel, approximate) + +64.5 measured source-wait difference (registered ledger, exact) + +31.0 veh-s unexplained residual (0.44%) attributable to integration-convention and region-coverage differences between the offline channel and the ledger; the 95.5 insertion-side term is forced by the identity but only 64.5 of it is independently measured - do not quote '95.5 measured insertion lag'. 'Zero through handback' is refined: the sampled in-network presence difference is exactly zero per tick through t=650 (first divergence t=667); small pre-648 insertion-side divergence cannot be excluded (CAV evidence: 264/282 first insertions identical). (2) BOUNDARY DEFECT: v1's trigger replay assessed the current bin at now = t + 1. Empirical per-tick comparison over 14,412 evaluated ticks shows 400 predicate-level differences (2.8%) - the repaired window is a strict superset that adds the last pre-decision second; with the recorded integer timestamps v1 could not admit post-decision reports, and ZERO trigger times or feasibility results changed (repair active at tick level, latent at result level). (3) REPLAY: the corrected v2 implementation (5/5 synthetic boundary tests) reproduces the OE-12 verdict exactly - 9/12 triggers within 2 s of t=600, later triggers 4134/4135/4137 all refused - so the 'rule not ready' conclusion stands on the repaired implementation.
